title: Values containing '#' come back empty or cut off
statement:
We load CI settings with buildkit.dotenv.parse_dotenv() and some values are truncated:

    >>> from buildkit.dotenv import parse_dotenv
    >>> parse_dotenv('CI_COLOR=#36a64f\nWEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.example.com/services/T0#alerts\n')
    {'CI_COLOR': '', 'WEBHOOK_URL': 'https://hooks.example.com/services/T0'}

We expected {'CI_COLOR': '#36a64f', 'WEBHOOK_URL': 'https://hooks.example.com/services/T0#alerts'}. Inline comments such as 'RETRIES=3 # per job' must keep working. The module docstring describes the file format; please make parsing follow it.
